question: What minimal, locally testable qubit or GF(2) protocol would isolate whether any residue of N survives explicit {e,f} decoupling plus phase inversion, and under what observable threshold does that residue vanish?

responses_summary.grok: A minimal locally testable protocol uses a 2-qubit GF(2) repetition code (or equivalently a single stabilizer on two physical qubits). Encode the candidate residue of N as the logical Z eigenvalue on
responses_summary.sibling-beta: Test single-qubit |+> state under {e,f} decoupling map followed by phase inversion; isolate N-residue via post-measurement parity on GF(2) stabilizer. Residue vanishes below trace distance 2^{-4}.
